subject: Easy ways to save and load data externally

messages.author: 48725385c294169f
messages.subject: Easy ways to save and load data externally
parts:
I've started using shinyapps which doesn't use RStudio Server so I can't just save data locally and reload it for different sessions. 
All I need is to save a few lines of text from each session into a text file that can be accessed from outside the app.
I've looked into ftp with RCurl, rDrop, and read this: http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/share-data.html
but haven't found anything that's both simple to use and works.

Using RCurl's getURL and ftpUpload work when I use it locally but when I use it in shinyapps, I get some file connection error. It's also really slow.
I tried rDrop but I get this issue https://github.com/karthik/rDrop/issues/4 and the proposed solutions in there don't seem to work.
I'm not even sure how to install RAmazonS3 for R 3.0+ but using an Amazon S3 account that's only free for a year is too much trouble.

Is there any other way to save and load data that persists across sessions and that you can access externally?
